title: POST /api/messages request body
description: What projects post to Muninn, with the ingest bearer token. Retrying is safe: a message id already seen is skipped. One malformed message rejects the whole post (400). Response: {"ok": true, "new": <count>}. `v` may be left out (read as 1); a version Muninn does not know is rejected. New fields may be added within v1.

id.description: The sender's message id: the idempotency key, and the key of a task it creates.

type.description: question: for the user to answer (the answer comes back as a handoff with reply_to = id). progress, done: reports; done with handoff_id closes that handoff, done with task closes that task; done or drop with question takes that question off the user's list (done: the user decided it where it was asked). task: something only the user can do. drop: the task, or the question, is no longer needed (needs task or question).

task.description: A task key (the id of the message that created it).

question.description: For done and drop: the id of a question the project asked the user that it no longer asks. It leaves the user's list. done says the user answered it in the project's own session (text: what the user decided): Muninn asks the user once whether that is right; nothing goes back if it is, and if it is not, the user's own answer comes back as a handoff (answers, reply_to = the question) whose why asks the project to look again at what it did on the wrong one. drop says it is no longer needed.

new_reason.description: For task: why this is new although it looks like one already settled.

inferred.description: For done and drop with task: true when the sender only inferred it (no one saw the user do it). Muninn then asks the user before closing the task, instead of closing it with an undo.
